Priya (Product): Thanks everyone — quick followups from today's all-hands. I wrote down a few concrete Qs about our mission focus and GTM tradeoffs. @Ari @Sam can you weigh in?
Ari (CEO): sure — fire away. trying to keep answers short so we can field many Qs. :+1:
Priya (Product): 1) How do we prioritize hosted API vs Dedicated sales targets? is the playbook different or one motion?
Ari (CEO): We treat them as two coordinated plays: hosted is our PLG funnel (velocity, low touch), Dedicated is sales-assisted (predictable capacity/SLA). Same product surface but different kickoff signals and metrics. Hosted = activation, DAU, net-new developer adoption. Dedicated = contract value, committed throughput.
Lucas (Growth): do we measure success differently per segment?
Ari (CEO): Yes. Hosted: conversion rate from free -> paid, unit economics per token. Dedicated: time-to-deal, renewal rate, NRR.
Priya (Product): 2) On mission: are we chasing model ownership or serving excellence as the north star?
Sam (CTO): serving excellence. models will fragment; our moat is consistent runtime+ops across environments. We pick a small set of verified models for easy onboarding but optimize serving (latency/cost/reliability).
Jamal (Eng): curious about tradeoffs — if an open model gives better quality but costs more to serve, do we default to quality or cost?
Sam (CTO): it depends on customer segment. For PLG/hosted, cost matters more to keep unit economics healthy — we use quantized variants or caching. For enterprise/Dedicated where performance and guarantees matter we bias to quality. We also support rollouts and automatic fallbacks.
Priya (Product): 3) Competitive angle — how do we talk about competing with cloud vendors + LLM APIs?
Ari (CEO): We emphasize production economics + unified experience (hosted+dedi+private). Not trying to be the broad cloud; we're the inference layer teams choose when latency, cost predictability, or private deployment matter.
Lucas (Growth): messaging question — should marketing lead with benchmarks or with use-cases?
Ari (CEO): both. Benchmarks for engineers and platform buyers, use-cases and outcomes for PMs/lines of business. Keep the story simple: predictable inference with fewer surprises.
Elena (Legal): quick note on private deployments — customers asking about audit logs & KMS. what's the plan?
Sam (CTO): Private includes audit logs + KMS integrations. For air-gapped on-prem we provide a packaging checklist and support plan; legal/compliance will join sales cycles.
Priya (Product): 4) Roadmap clarity: what launches should teams expect in the next 90 days that materially affect GTM?
Ari (CEO): three things: 1) Dedicated autoscaling policies (makes sales easier), 2) Cost analyzer in Console (token-level cost breakdowns for customers), 3) Model index + verified perf profiles (reduces onboarding friction).
Jamal (Eng): timeline on the cost analyzer? can early access customers try it?
Priya (Product): Beta next month, early access for top Hosted customers and Dedicated pilots.
Priya (Product): 5) Metrics — what are our 6-month targets for 'win signals' leadership wants to see?
Ari (CEO): increase Hosted conversion by 25%, close 10 new Dedicated deals, and reduce median hosted tail latency by 15%. Those are directional but will guide prioritization.
Lucas (Growth): are there specific verticals to prioritize for Dedicated?
Ari (CEO): focus on fintech and healthcare first (regulated, latency-sensitive). later expand to adtech and enterprise productivity.
Priya (Product): last one — if someone in product/eng wants to propose a tradeoff (quality vs cost) who should they loop in?
Sam (CTO): loop in me + the ML infra lead + the customer success PM owning the affected customers. keep short PRD with perf/cost numbers.
Priya (Product): great — thanks all. I'll collate and share a short follow-up doc.
